summary: All five requirements (REQ-1 through REQ-5) have been implemented across frontend and backend. The diff shows: (1) Date/time pickers added to SalesForm and ShiftManagement components, (2) Open/end totalizer fields added to SalesForm with automatic volume calculation and validation, (3) Backend Sale and Shift types updated with new fields (openTotalizer, endTotalizer, saleDate, shiftDate), (4) Migration script created to handle data migration, and (5) API hooks updated to pass new parameters.
